apiVersionNote: Single constant to bump when Meta deprecates a version; versions are supported ~2 years.
tokenNote: System-user token with ads_management + ads_read, created 2026-09-16 (02 §Meta). Meta tokens expire ~60 days; fb-manage-daily alerts at day 50 (04 §1 item 6).

campaign.name: CAMP 01 | Andromeda
campaign.optimizationNote: 04 §2.1: optimize on Lead at launch; fb-manage-daily flips ad sets to the qualified_demo custom conversion once one has >= 25 qualified_demo events / 30 days.
campaign.budgetNote: 04 §8: CAMP 01 goes live at $50/day (Oct 2026) = 4 module ad sets x $12.50. Budgets live at ad-set level (04 §6); fb-manage-daily never raises the account total more than 30%/day.
campaign.exclusionsNote: 04 §6: EXCL_InstalledBase / EXCL_Customers / EXCL_Employees / EXCL_Converted_365 on every ad set before anything goes ACTIVE. The audiences do not exist yet (pixel live 2026-09-16); ads-guardrails-daily's meta-targeting-exclusions critical check is the backstop. Add the audience ids here once built.
campaign.adSetsNote: 04 §6: one broad Advantage+ ad set per module; ads within it span all personas. Persona P5 has module 'all' in matrix.json — no ad set is mapped for it, so P5 creatives are skipped and alerted until a human decides where platform-wide ads live.
